ALLPOWERS.tiers_mechanics: Brand does not say whether tiers apply automatically or need a code. Terms section 4: 'These percentage tiers are alternatives, not cumulative discounts. Check the cart and checkout for eligible items, the order value used to determine the threshold and the actual discount applied.' Whether the threshold is measured before or after sale prices/codes is not stated. Context from Dealectric's own log (src/coupons.json, cart tests 2026-11-15, not a brand statement): the cart showed an automatic 5% off with no code on single kits under $1,000 (e.g. $698 -> $663.10, $848 -> $805.60, $948 -> $900.60).
ALLPOWERS.stacking: No firm rule published. Terms section 7 (https://iallpowers.com/pages/black-friday-sale-2026): 'Sale prices, order-value savings, individual codes and rewards cannot necessarily be combined; a combination applies only if it is actually accepted at checkout.' Section 4: 'A sale price on a product card does not by itself guarantee an additional discount.' Section 3: 'Benefits for one phase do not apply retrospectively or automatically carry over to orders placed in another phase.' Section 9: a cancelled or returned order 'may change' eligibility for the order-value benefit. No published exclusions list (accessories, flash-deal items, bundles are not named either way). So whether a code (e.g. Dealectric's DEALECTRIC10) stacks with sale prices and the order-value tier is only answerable by cart test.

tiers.mechanics: Automatic. Terms 3a: 'The highest applicable discount tier will automatically apply to qualifying orders at checkout, where applicable.' 'The discount is based on the eligible order subtotal after other discounts and before taxes and shipping fees.' 'Each qualifying order is eligible for only one discount tier. Discounts are not cumulative.' Also shown on product pages: 'Spend $2,000+ to save $50, $3,000+ to save $100, or $4,000+ to save $150.'

BLUETTI.stacking: Early Access terms (https://www.bluettipower.com/pages/black-friday): spend tiers 'cannot be combined with other promotions unless otherwise specified', yet the tier is 'based on the eligible order subtotal after other discounts', i.e. it is computed after sale prices and any code. Section 4 Coupon Use: 'Only one coupon code may be used per order unless otherwise stated.' 'Coupons may be subject to minimum spend, expiry dates, and product exclusions.' Lucky Draw prizes, Bucks redemptions and the kids' gift each say 'cannot be combined with other promotions unless otherwise specified.' 'Adding an item to the shopping cart does not guarantee product availability or lock in promotional pricing.' No published exclusion list for accessories, flash items or bundles in the BF terms. Context (Dealectric's own records, not a brand statement): DEALECTRIC (Awin) is '5% off sitewide, excluding accessories and flash-sale items' and was rejected on 2026-11-02 while the AC180 carried an automatic store discount; the 2026-11-15 cart tests in src/coupons.json logged DEALECTRIC discounts on Apex 300 bundles whose no-code totals already showed the $50/$100 tier, which suggests code + tier went through together - re-test now.

BLUETTI.price_protection: Black Friday page: 'Price Guarantee - Find a lower price within 30 days? We'll refund the difference.' and '30-Day Price Match - If the official BLUETTI price drops within 30 days of your purchase, we'll refund the difference' (links to /policies/refund-policy, which has no price-match text). AC180 product page: '30 Days Price Match Guarantee - BLUETTI guarantees that we will refund you the difference if you find a lower price from us within 30 days of your purchase. Price Difference Refund Requirements: 1. Valid purchase history within 30 days. 2. Email us a screenshot of the lower price. 3. Promotion period only.' How-to-buy FAQ (https://www.bluettipower.com/pages/how-to-buy): 'If the price decreases on the same platform within 30 days of purchase, we'll refund the difference. Excludes flash sales and special promotions.' Buying guide: 'Do not assume every promotional configuration automatically qualifies.' So: own-store price drops only, claim by email with screenshot; the FAQ's exclusion of 'special promotions' conflicts with the BF page's promise.

BLUETTI.gaps: (1) Main sale (Nov 19-30) and Cyber Monday (Dec 1-5) offers, prices, tiers and clock times are not published; the only source for those dates is the 11-05 buying guide. Re-read https://www.bluettipower.com/pages/black-friday on Nov 19 after 00:00 PST. (3) The 'AC180' coupon on the AC180 page: literal code or widget label, amount and dates unknown; AC180 is out of stock anyway (restock late Nov / ships 12.14). (4) Price guarantee: BF page promises 30-day refund of the difference, FAQ excludes 'flash sales and special promotions', AC180 page says 'Promotion period only'. (5) Financing provider/promo not identified. (6) Several items have no compare-at price in the store data (AC180, Elite 200 V2 line, Elite 30 V2 line, Elite 100 V2, Elite 100 mini, Elite 300, AC200L), so 'was' prices for those are not brand-stated. (7) Prices changed since Dealectric's cart tests: AC180 $499 -> $549. (8) Internal page config on the BF page sets the /pages/black-friday window to 2026-11-03T16:00Z - 2026-12-09T16:00Z (a tracking setting, not a shopper-facing date).
